Neither the GitHub README nor the OpenAI blog post states a publication date in their own extracted text; the exact date is corroborated by the GitHub repository's earliest commits, all timestamped 2018-06-11T06:04–07:00 UTC per the GitHub API. No index-basket benchmark scores were officially reported for GPT-1 (its evaluation suite predates MMLU/HellaSwag/GSM8K-era benchmarks); recorded with zero scores so it still appears as a timeline tick.
